Program cache fork lookup, insertion, invalidation, and metrics handling.

# Purpose
This file implements the program cache layer for `funk`-backed program records. It provides the main runtime API to join and leave a cache instance with shared memory, track cache metrics, and manage cache state across transaction forks. The code uses `fd_funk` transaction and record maps to find, insert, and invalidate cached program entries by program address and transaction XID. It also keeps a fork list in [`fd_progcache_load_fork`](<#fd_progcache_load_fork>) so lookups only use records that belong to the active transaction branch and do not cross an epoch boundary.

The file also contains the cache miss and fill path. [`fd_progcache_pull`](<#fd_progcache_pull>) searches for an existing record, checks invalidation state, and inserts a new cache entry when needed. [`fd_progcache_insert`](<#fd_progcache_insert>) loads ELF program data with `fd_prog_load_elf`, builds a `fd_progcache_rec_t`, and publishes it into the record map with transaction locking and duplicate insert handling. [`fd_progcache_invalidate`](<#fd_progcache_invalidate>) creates tombstone records for invalidation events. The file exposes the external cache operations [`fd_progcache_join`](<#fd_progcache_join>), [`fd_progcache_leave`](<#fd_progcache_leave>), [`fd_progcache_peek_exact`](<#fd_progcache_peek_exact>), [`fd_progcache_peek`](<#fd_progcache_peek>), [`fd_progcache_pull`](<#fd_progcache_pull>), and [`fd_progcache_invalidate`](<#fd_progcache_invalidate>).
